description:
My name is Barrett Floyd. Twenty-six years with the Police Department, nine of them in burglary, then eleven running the crime prevention unit. That last job meant I walked into strangers' houses by appointment and told them what was wrong with them. Somewhere around two thousand front doors.

Before that I sat across a table from about three hundred men who made a living going through those doors. A fair number of them talked.

This channel is what I used to say standing in people's living rooms. What actually stops somebody, what's a waste of your money, and what costs four dollars and ten minutes.

I'm not here to scare anybody. New video every week.

Cheryl thinks I talk too much about screws.

Lock it behind you.
